headline: FOMC day (most contested in a decade, 9-9 split): everything coiled in wedges into 2:00 — intraday leans to a squeeze higher into resistance; the real trend shows after 3:00.
market_state: FOMC DAY — statement 2:00, presser 2:30 (crude inventories 10:30). Fed-watch 54.5% Sept hike; a 2nd 2026 hike is NOT yet in the mainstream narrative (arguably unpriced). 'Most important FOMC in a decade,' ~9-9 split, Warsh gave no forward guidance. Regime: deflationary boom (crude down, gold selling, indices holding in traditional shorts). Markets coiled in tight wedges pre-FOMC.
bias: Intraday BULLISH squeeze into resistance favored (path of least resistance): dollar in an intraday weakness leg, bank grinding higher (financial strength), VIX wedged/likely back to support — all tailwinds toward Monday's highs where 'Wall Street gets its fill' (~2475s). Longer term still DOWN (dollar up; indices in traditional shorts). Don't predict — the true trend reveals after 3:00.
